cases.explain: «лживые дети» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear Yahweh’s law;

cases.explain: «глиняный сосуд» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”

cases.sentence: В тот день твой скот будет пастись на ___.
cases.explain: «широких лугах» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

cases.sentence: В день ___, когда обрушатся башни, по каждой высокой горе и по каждому высокому холму побегут потоки воды.
cases.explain: «великой бойни» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

cases.sentence: В день великой бойни, когда обрушатся башни, по каждой ___ и по каждому высокому холму побегут потоки воды.
cases.explain: «высокой горе» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

cases.sentence: В день великой бойни, когда обрушатся башни, по каждой высокой горе и по каждому ___ побегут потоки воды.
cases.explain: «высокому холму» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

cases.sentence: Луна будет сиять, как солнце, а ___ станет в семь раз ярче, словно свет семи полных дней, когда Господь перевяжет язвы Своего народа и исцелит раны, которые Он нанес.
cases.explain: «солнечный свет» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

cases.sentence: Луна будет сиять, как солнце, а солнечный свет станет в семь раз ярче, словно свет семи ___, когда Господь перевяжет язвы Своего народа и исцелит раны, которые Он нанес.
cases.explain: «полных дней» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

cases.explain: «величественный голос» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Yahweh will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.
